items.rationale: Ciorbă de perișoare is a concrete familiar Romanian soup. Independent original recipes from2010and2014 establish enduring household recognition. Meat and lovage are ingredients; rice is a common optional meatball ingredient, explicitly included by one author and discussed but omitted by Jamila. Chiftele is an association between minced-meat preparations, not a claim that fried patties are added to soup. Five real incoming neighbors give hot feedback; ordinary mâncare/ciorbă/supă approaches are useful. No new factual claim requires one universal recipe. The exact allocated-ID pending dossier was independently regenerated and byte-matches. All applicable recognition, predicate, novelty and B/C/D requirements were reviewed; current101-caption text is part of the dossier. This is an agent judgment, not a measured enjoyment study.

Coapsă, Gambă, Genunchi and Călcâi are parts of the lower limb in ordinary Romanian picior usage; a narrow medical foot-only reading is not the group meaning. Carte, Revistă, Ziar and Abecedar are printed publications in the displayed identities. Century, year, week and calendar month are calendar units. Carpet beating during cleaning, beating egg whites and cream during preparation, and flattening the meat when preparing schnitzel are ordinary documented household/cooking uses of a bate. The label explicitly locates the operation in preparation or cleaning, not violence or hitting the finished dish.
